これに対し３社は、取材排除は憲法修正第１条に違反し、報道内容への報復措置だとして政権を提訴。ホワイトハウスを取材する主要テレビ５社は連帯して取材を停止した。

item.title: Canadian ransomware negotiator arrested amid FBI hacker crackdown
item.description: A Canadian ransomware negotiator was arrested Thursday and faces unspecified extortion charges, according to court documents, prison records and a person familiar with the matter, as the FBI cracks down on a hacking group that stole information about its employees.
item.dc:creator: Raphael Satter, A.J. Vicens
item.content:encoded: A Canadian ransomware negotiator was arrested Thursday and faces unspecified extortion charges, according to court documents, prison records and a person familiar with the matter, as the FBI cracks down on a hacking group that stole information about its employees. Edward Dubrovsky faces charges of conspiracy to "threaten to impair the confidentiality of information with intent to extort money" and "interference with commerce," according to court documents filed with the Eastern District of Pennsylvania, which covers Philadelphia. The records, which are partially sealed, provide conflicting spellings of his last name — "Dobrovsky" or "Dobrosky" — and do not identify his age, profession, or employer. A person briefed on the matter said the person was Canadian cybersecurity executive Edward Dubrovsky. Federal prosecutors in Philadelphia did not return repeated messages seeking comment about the discrepancies. Attempts to reach Dubrovsky and his attorneys were unsuccessful. Repeated attempts to reach the company displayed on Dubrovsky's LinkedIn profile, CyberSteward, were similarly unsuccessful. CyberSteward advertises itself online as specializing in "threat actor engagement, cyber-extortions, complex negotiations, and settlement facilitation." On LinkedIn, Dubrovsky presents himself as a specialist in the process of negotiating with cybercriminals over ransom payments. Electronic wallet records leaked in 2010 and preserved by dark-web intelligence firm District 4 Labs identify Dubrovsky as a resident of Richmond Hill, north of Toronto, and put his current age at 54. Federal prison records show that a 54-year-old named Edward Dubrovsky is currently being detained at a federal detention center in Philadelphia. News of Dubrovsky's arrest was earlier reported by Politico and independent journalist Brian Krebs . The arrest comes as the Federal Bureau of Investigation is leading a global crackdown on the hacking group ShinyHunters, which rattled the bureau last month by stealing information on what it said was [USN:L6N45E0VU TEXT:"nearly every FBI employee"]. When Reuters asked the FBI about Dubrovsky's arrest, it referred the news agency to FBI Director Kash Patel's [USN:L6N45V0R8 TEXT:"statement on Friday"] revealing that the bureau had arrested a "suspected co-conspirator of the ShinyHunters group" and declined further comment.

item.title: William Nylander (5 points) propels Maple Leafs past Avalanche
item.description: William Nylander had two goals and three assists, Auston Matthews had two goals and two assists, and the Toronto Maple Leafs beat the Colorado Avalanche 6-3 in Denver on Saturday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: William Nylander had two goals and three assists, Auston Matthews had two goals and two assists, and the Toronto Maple Leafs beat the Colorado Avalanche 6-3 in Denver on Saturday night. Nylander's three assists and five points matched his career highs. Easton Cowan and Nick Blankenburg also scored, Nick Paul had two assists and Sergei Bobrovsky turned away 30 shots for Toronto. The Maple Leafs have split the first two games of their three-game road trip. Nathan MacKinnon had two goals, Brock Nelson also scored and Mackenzie Blackwood had 17 saves for Colorado. The Avalanche lost for the first time in three home games this season. Blankenburg gave Toronto the early advantage when he scored from close range at 3:03 of the first period, but MacKinnon asserted himself the rest of the period. He took a pass from Brett Kulak in the neutral zone, skated through the Maple Leafs defense and slid the puck through Bobrovsky's pads at 10:46 to tie it. MacKinnon gave Colorado a 2-1 lead later in the period when his screened shot from between the faceoff circles beat Bobrovsky high to the stick side at 15:14. The Avalanche had a chance to extend the lead with consecutive power plays at the start of the second but couldn't score. Toronto took advantage of its first power-play chance when Nylander got a pass from Gavin McKenna to the right of Blackwood, deked the goaltender and tucked the puck on the opposite side at 6:53. Colorado took a 3-2 lead later in the second when Nelson cleaned up his own rebound and fluttered a shot over Bobrovsky at 12:25, but the Maple Leafs responded twice in less than a minute. Nylander's second of the night, at 16:47, tied the game, and Cowan made it 4-3 with a one-timer on a pass from Morgan Rielly at 17:33. Matthews scored a power-play goal at 12:02 of the third period and added an empty-netter in the final minute after Blackwood came off for an extra skater. --Field Level Media

item.title: Blues snap 3-game skid, score season-high 5 goals to edge Blue Jackets
item.description: Jimmy Snuggerud scored two second-period goals in quick succession and Jonatan Berggren scored the game-winning goal to help the St. Louis Blues halt their three-game slide with a 5-3 home victory over the Columbus Blue Jackets on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Jimmy Snuggerud scored two second-period goals in quick succession and Jonatan Berggren scored the game-winning goal to help the St. Louis Blues halt their three-game slide with a 5-3 home victory over the Columbus Blue Jackets on Saturday. The Blues entered the matchup buried in offensive woes during their three-game losing skid, but found their flow as Jake Neighbours and Pavel Buchnevich also found the back of the net and Dylan Holloway picked up three assists. Jordan Binnington made 20 saves as he recorded his first victory of the season. Cole Sillinger, Kent Johnson, and Valeri Nichushkin lit the lamp for the Blue Jackets, while Jet Greaves finished with 22 saves. With a delayed penalty forthcoming, Berggren went hard to the front of the net and found a loose puck to score the eventual game-winning goal with just over 10 minutes remaining. After a quiet start to the contest, the Blue Jackets broke the deadlock with 3:50 left in the first period as Erik Gudbranson sent a pass that redirected off the side of the net and Sean Monahan's shot banked in off Nichushkin for his first goal as a Blue Jacket. Johnson doubled up the lead with 12 seconds left in the opening frame as he cut into the middle and wired a shot off the far post and past Binnington. Neighbours made it a one-goal game with 13:50 remaining in the middle frame as he found the puck near the Blue Jackets' net and fired it home. Snuggerud knotted things up just under three minutes later as Philip Broberg carried the puck in wide and slid a pass across that hit the young forward's skate and bounced in. The 2022 first-round pick kept it rolling with his second of the night with 7:28 left in the second as he patiently waited and then perfectly placed a shot under the blocker of Greaves. Sillinger took advantage of some poor rebound control from Binnington to tie the game back up with 13:09 left in the third period. Buchnevich put the game to rest with an empty-net goal. Each team only had one power-play chance on the night and neither was successful. --Field Level Media

item.title: Big second period propels Hurricanes past Blackhawks
item.description: Jackson Blake and Jordan Martinook both scored once and added an assist, and the visiting Carolina Hurricanes used a three-goal second period to beat the slumping Chicago Blackhawks 5-2 on Saturday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Jackson Blake and Jordan Martinook both scored once and added an assist, and the visiting Carolina Hurricanes used a three-goal second period to beat the slumping Chicago Blackhawks 5-2 on Saturday night. Mark Jankowski, Sebastian Aho and Taylor Hall also scored for the Hurricanes, who have won four straight games. All four Carolina forward lines lit the lamp. Goaltender Brandon Bussi made 24 saves and Mike Reilly collected two assists. Roman Kantserov, with his first NHL goal, and Oliver Moore replied for the Blackhawks, while goalie Spencer Knight made 34 saves. Chicago has just one win in six games to start the season. After dominating play from the drop of the puck, the Hurricanes finally pulled ahead when Jankowski converted a breakaway with 56.2 seconds remaining in the first period. He has scored in three consecutive games for the first time in his 11-year NHL career. That tally sparked the defending Stanley Cup champions. Aho doubled the lead when he buried a shot from the slot after neatly eluding a check at 2:09 of the second period. Blake gave the visitors a three-goal lead 79 seconds later by converting from the doorstep for his first goal of the season. Kantserov provided the Blackhawks a boost when he tallied on a breakaway for his milestone marker, a huge boost for the 2023 second-round draft pick, at 4:40 of the middle frame. However, Hall restored Carolina's three-goal lead 85 seconds later by unloading a one-timer from the high slot. Martinook extended the edge with his first of the season, a backhanded shot from the slot at 5:00 of the third period. Moore rounded out the scoring with less than six minutes remaining. --Field Level Media

item.title: Kipchoge wins first marathon in three years in Melbourne
item.description: Kenya's twice Olympic champion Eliud Kipchoge won the Melbourne Marathon in a course record of 2 hours, 9 minutes and 10 seconds on Sunday, claiming his 17th win over the distance at age 41.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Kenya's twice Olympic champion Eliud Kipchoge won the Melbourne Marathon in a course record of 2 hours, 9 minutes and 10 seconds on Sunday, claiming his 17th win over the distance at age 41. Kipchoge is attempting to run a marathon on all seven continents over two years, having launched his continental campaign at the Cape Town Marathon [USN:L1N3ZX0XB TEXT:"in May"]. Sunday's win was his first in three years, after he won Berlin in 2023 for [USN:L2N3VP0S3 TEXT:"a record"] 11th title at the majors. "I believe that my body is still peaking – still able to compete with the next generation," Kipchoge told reporters after the race. "The oldest athlete is still competing but I am happy to run with the Gen Zs. I (increased) the pace after 30 km, to see whether I can run well and beat the (race record). My plan went well." Australian Thomas Do Canto finished second behind Kipchoge at 2:10:35, while compatriot Reece Edwards was third at 2:14:33. New Zealand's Camille French won the women's race in 2:28:25, followed by Australian Sinead Diver at 2:28:49 and Nichola Sheridan of Ireland at 2:29:13.

item.title: テニス＝マスターズ上海大会、第2シードのアルカラス3回戦進出
item.description: ［１０日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１０日　ロイター］ - テニスのマスターズ上海大会は１０日、男子シングルス２回戦を行い、第２シードのカルロス・アルカラス（スペイン）が３回戦に進んだ。

アルカラスはフアンマヌエル・セルンドロ（アルゼンチン）に６─３、６─３で快勝。８本のサービスエースを放ち、ブレークポイントは１回も握られなかった。ウィナーの本数でも２４─８と上回り、わずか６７分で勝利を収めた。

スペイン人男子による同大会初優勝を目指すアルカラスは、次戦でジズー・ベルグス（ベルギー）と対戦する。ベルグスは２回戦で第３２シードのイグナシオ・ブセ（ペルー）を６─０、６─３で下した。

第４シードのフェリックス・オジェアリアシム（カナダ）、ロシア出身で第５シードのダニル・メドベージェフはともにフルセットで勝ち上がり。第８シードのアルトゥール・フィス（フランス）、第１１シードのテーラー・フリッツ（米国）らも勝ち上がった。

item.title: Ｆ１＝シンガポールＧＰ予選、フェルスタッペンがＰＰ獲得
item.description: ［シンガポール １０日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［シンガポール　１０日　ロイター］　 - 自動車レースＦ１の第１７戦、シンガポール・グランプリ（ＧＰ）は１０日、予選を行い、マックス・フェルスタッペン（オランダ、レッドブル）が２戦連続、キャリア通算５０回目のポールポジション（ＰＰ）を獲得した。

４回の個人総合優勝を誇るフェルスタッペンにとって、今回がＦ１での通算２５０戦目。シャルル・ルクレール（モナコ）が２番手、ルイス・ハミルトン（英国）が３番手とフェラーリ勢が続き、総合首位のキミ・アントネッリ（イタリア、メルセデス）が４番手だった。

昨季の総合王者ランド・ノリス（英国、マクラーレン）は５番手。総合２位のジョージ・ラッセル（英国、メルセデス）は６番手だったが、エンジンのペナルティーにより、決勝では最後尾からのスタートとなる。ノリスの同僚、オスカー・ピアストリ（オーストラリア）は７番手のタイムを計測した。

予選の前に行われたスプリントではフェルスタッペンが勝利。ハミルトンが２位、ルクレールが３位、アントネッリが４位だった。ノリスとピアストリが接触したが、ともにペナルティーは受けなかった。

item.title: US military says it disabled cargo vessel trying to run Iran blockade
item.description: The US military said on Saturday it had disabled a commercial cargo vessel in the Gulf of Oman after the ship's crew ignored warnings and attempted to run a naval blockade against Iran.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The US military said on Saturday it had disabled a commercial cargo vessel in the Gulf of Oman after the ship's crew ignored warnings and attempted to run a naval blockade against Iran. "A U.S. military fighter jet struck the stern of Panama-flagged M/V Ocean Molica (also known as the “Arika Sun”) with a precision munition, fully disabling the ship’s propulsion without harming the crew," the US Central Command posted on X. CENTCOM said the cargo vessel had attempted to transit regional waters after leaving an Iranian port. Reuters was not immediately able to reach the bulk carrier's operator for comment. CENTCOM warned mariners in the Gulf of Oman and the approaches to the Strait of Hormuz to heed blockade warnings, monitor notice-to-mariners broadcasts and contact US naval forces. The number of vessels [USN:L1N45U0AH TEXT:"transiting"] the vital strait fell to the lowest in more than two months after attacks on tankers reached their highest level last week since the US and Israel launched the war on Iran in February, raising concerns over shipping disruptions and supporting crude prices. Before the war, the Strait of Hormuz carried 20% of the world's oil consumption.

item.title: 成長の好循環「少しずつ見えてきた」、定着へ責任ある積極財政＝官房長官
item.description: ［東京 １１日 ロイター］ - 木原稔官房長官は１１日のＮＨＫの報道番組に出演し、高市早苗政権の経済政策により成長の...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
成長の好循環「少しずつ見えてきた」、定着へ責任ある積極財政＝官房長官 10:20 配信

首相官邸で会見する木原稔官房長官。７月１４日、東京で撮影（２０２６年　ロイター/Kim Kyung-Hoon）

［東京　１１日　ロイター］ - 木原稔官房長官は１１日のＮＨＫの報道番組に出演し、高市早苗政権の経済政策により成長の好循環が少しずつ見えてきたと指摘し、変化の兆しが定着するまで「しっかりと責任ある積極財政」を行う考えを示した。

木原氏は、設備投資や雇用の増加が賃金上昇につながり、消費の増加、企業の事業収益、税収増などにつながる成長の好循環が少しずつ見えてきたと分析した。責任ある積極財政により、国内投資を引き出し、潜在成長率を引き上げ、「ＧＤＰが拡大していく中で成長の好循環を実現していきたい」と語った。

物価高対策に関連して補正予算を編成する可能性を問われると、「エネルギー価格の変動にこれから注目していきたい」とした上で、ガソリン価格を１リットル当たり１７０円に抑えている現状を改めて説明。「これに加えて何をしていくかということは、しっかりと影響を注視していきたい」と話した。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：米中間選、暗号資産業界が抱えるジレンマ　民主党へ報復か関係維持か 焦点：「米国ファースト」が招いたコンゴのエボラ医療逼迫、帰国制限で米国人医師ら援助に二の足 アングル：日韓で不正アクセスの「じゅうたん爆撃」、ＡＩ使いサイバー攻撃が手軽に アングル：米中間選「ねじれ」でも株高の経験則、今年はＡＩ規制に要警戒 アングル：金価格、米国債利回り上昇でも4000ドル台維持　中銀の準備資産分散が下支え 最終更新: 10/11(日) 10:20 ロイター

item.title: サッカー＝田中先発のリーズ、昨季王者アーセナルに逆転負け
item.description: ［ロンドン １０日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［ロンドン　１０日　ロイター］　 - サッカーのイングランド・プレミアリーグは１０日、各地で試合を行い、田中碧が所属するリーズは昨季王者アーセナルに１─２の逆転負けを喫した。

リーズは後半１０分にジェームズ・ジャスティンのゴールで先制したが、その７分後にアーセナルのリッカルド・カラフィオーリに同点ゴールを献上。さらに同２５分、途中出場のブルーノ・ギマランイスにゴール隅へのシュートを決められた。田中は先発し、後半２６分までプレーした。

ＧＫ鈴木彩艶がフル出場したアストンビラはブレントフォードと２─２のドロー。前田大然が所属するイプスウィッチはフラムに２─１で逆転勝ち。前田は先発し、後半３６分までピッチに立った。三笘薫が所属するブライトンはサンダーランドに２─０で勝利。三笘はベンチ入りしなかった。

この他、チェルシーはボーンマスに５─１で圧勝。マンチェスター・ユナイテッドはトットナムと１─１で引き分けた。

６試合を消化したアーセナルが首位マンチェスター・シティー（マンＣ）と同じ勝ち点１５に伸ばし、２位に浮上した。ブライトンが同１３で３位。マンＣは１１日、敵地でリバプールと対戦する。

item.title: Bills WR DJ Moore questionable, DT Ed Oliver out vs. Rams
item.description: Buffalo Bills receiver DJ Moore was a limited practice participant on Saturday due to his shoulder injury and was listed as questionable for Monday night's road game against the Los Angeles Rams.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Buffalo Bills receiver DJ Moore was a limited practice participant on Saturday due to his shoulder injury and was listed as questionable for Monday night's road game against the Los Angeles Rams. Star defensive tackle Ed Oliver (knee) and receiver Joshua Palmer (shoulder) were ruled out by the Bills. Palmer was added to the report on Friday and missed Saturday's session. Moore injured his left shoulder for the second time this season in the second quarter of last Sunday's 29-26 loss to the New England Patriots. Oliver was injured in the third quarter against New England. Moore, 29, has 12 receptions for 178 yards and one touchdown in four games this season. He was obtained in the offseason from the Chicago Bears. Oliver, 28, has nine tackles, one fumble recovery and half a sack in three games this season. Cornerback Dee Alford (ankle) and defensive lineman Landon Jackson (knee) are also questionable for Buffalo. For the Rams, safety Quentin Lake (hip) is questionable. Star defensive lineman Aaron Donald (back) didn't practice Saturday but is good to go for the contest. Also, Los Angeles coach Sean McVay said defensive end Myles Garrett is progressing from knee surgery but the team is unlikely to open his 21-day practice window next week. Garrett struggled in the season-opening loss against the San Francisco 49ers and cited knee irritation as a factor. The Rams placed him on injured reserve on Sept. 17. "He's making good progress," McVay told reporters. "As far as what that timeline looks like, it's kind of week-to-week in terms of how he feels. But I would say it's more likely that we do not start his clock next week." Garrett, the reigning NFL Defensive Player of the Year, was acquired from the Cleveland Browns in the offseason. --Field Level Media

item.title: Kirill Kaprizov nets hat trick as Wild hand Panthers rare loss
item.description: Kirill Kaprizov tallied his seventh career hat trick and added an assist, and the Minnesota Wild pulled away for a 4-1 win over the Florida Panthers on Saturday evening in Sunrise, Fla.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Kirill Kaprizov tallied his seventh career hat trick and added an assist, and the Minnesota Wild pulled away for a 4-1 win over the Florida Panthers on Saturday evening in Sunrise, Fla. Matt Boldy finished with a goal and an assist for Minnesota, which snapped a two-game winless skid. Quinn Hughes was one of four other Wild players to tally an assist. Matthew Tkachuk scored the lone goal for Florida. The outcome marked the Panthers' first loss in regulation in five games this season. Wild goaltender Jesper Wallstedt stopped 29 of 30 shots to earn the victory. Panthers goaltender Jacob Markstrom allowed three goals on 28 shots. Minnesota jumped out to a 1-0 lead in the first minute of the game. Boldy carried the puck into the offensive zone and fired a wrist shot above Markstrom's left shoulder 53 seconds in. The Wild increased their lead to 2-0 with a power-play goal at 6:18 of the first period. Maxim Shabanov fed a cross-ice pass to Kaprizov, who buried a one-timer from the right circle. Florida cut the deficit to 2-1 at 2:18 of the second period. Tkachuk kept the puck on a two-on-one rush but his shot was kicked out by Wallstedt. Tkachuk followed the rebound and scored on his second chance from near the front of the crease. Kaprizov struck again to boost the Wild's lead to 3-1 at 5:00 of the second. He scored on a wrist shot from the right circle. The Wild's top scorer finished his hat trick with an empty-net goal at 18:56 of the third. Kaprizov got the puck in Minnesota's defensive zone and flipped a long shot into the open net for his sixth goal in five games this season. Wild forward Rieger Lorenz made his NHL debut. The 22-year-old Calgary native was Minnesota's second-round pick (No. 56 overall) in the 2022 NHL Draft. --Field Level Media

item.title: South Korea completes Arctic-Europe commercial voyage, eyes regular service despite risks
item.description: A South Korean container ship completed the country's first commercial round trip to Europe via the Arctic on Sunday, as authorities bank on the route helping turn the port of Busan into a global maritime hub.
item.dc:creator: Joyce Lee
item.content:encoded: A South Korean container ship completed the country's first commercial round trip to Europe via the Arctic on Sunday, as authorities bank on the route helping turn the port of Busan into a global maritime hub. The PanStar Acro docked in the southeastern port 50 days after setting sail on August 22. Authorities say the Arctic route could cut typical voyage times by around a third. President Lee Jae Myung has made Arctic shipping a priority, and officials hope to launch regular services by 2030. But the project [USN:L1N44J01G TEXT:"risks friction"] with Western allies hoping to keep Russia isolated during its war in Ukraine. The route runs along Russia's Arctic coast, and Seoul consulted with Moscow about the journey, including whether the ship needed help to tackle any problems, such as getting stuck in ice. On its outbound voyage, the vessel passed through Arctic waters and reached its first European port, Felixstowe in Britain, before calling at Rotterdam and Gdansk and returning home via the Arctic. The trial voyage also highlighted the challenges ahead. Before the departure, PanStar told Reuters it was seeking about 1,300 twenty-foot equivalent units of cargo, but the ship left with 737 TEU of cargo plus empty containers. Industry experts have said the route's value will depend on reliable schedules, the costs of slowing to avoid ice, special insurance premiums and extra fuel use.

item.title: サッカー＝バイエルン最速失点許すも引き分け、伊藤は出番な
item.description: ［アウクスブルク（ドイツ） １０日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［アウクスブルク（ドイツ）　１０日　ロイター］ - サッカーのドイツ１部ブンデスリーガは１０日、各地で試合を行い、伊藤洋輝が所属するバイエルン・ミュンヘンはアウクスブルクに２回リードされながらも追い付き、２─２で引き分けた。

バイエルンは開始８秒、ＧＫマヌエル・ノイアーが味方に出そうとしたパスをロビン・フェルハウアーに奪われ、同リーグ史上最速での失点を喫した。

後半１０分にハリー・ケーンのラストパスをイスマエル・サイバリが決めて追い付くも、その９分後、ノイアーがロドリゴ・リベイロの前にボールを弾き、これを押し込まれて１─２に。それでも最後はケーンのお膳立てからナサニエル・ブラウンがネットを揺らし、ドローに持ち込んだ。伊藤はベンチ入りしたが出番はなかった。

佐野海舟が先発出場したマインツはレーバークーゼンに３─４で敗れた。立ち上がりの２失点を前半のうちに返したが、後半に再び２失点。同アディショナルタイム２分に１点を返すにとどまった。佐野は同３６分までプレー。川崎颯太はベンチ入りしたが出場しなかった。

小杉啓太と堂安律が先発したアイントラハト・フランクフルトはライプチヒに０─６の大敗。クリストファー・エンクンクのハットトリックを許すなど前半のうちに０─４と大きくリードされ、後半も反撃できないまま２点を追加された。小杉は前半のみの出場。堂安は後半２８分までプレーした。

町田浩樹所属のホッフェンハイムはハンブルガーＳＶに２─３で黒星。先発した町田は後半２９分までピッチに立った。

５試合を終えてバイエルンは勝ち点１１で首位ドルトムントと２差の暫定２位。マインツは同７で暫定８位、フランクフルトは同５で暫定１３位、ホッフェンハイムは同３で暫定１７位としている。

item.title: ゴルフ＝砂川が日本勢最高17位に浮上、ベイカレント・クラシック
item.description: ［１０日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１０日　ロイター］ - 米男子ゴルフの秋季シリーズ、ベイカレント・クラシック・レクサスは１０日、神奈川県横浜ＣＣ（パー７１）で第３ラウンドを行い、砂川公佑が日本勢最高の１７位に順位を上げた。

３０位でスタートした砂川は６バーディー、２ボギーの４アンダー６７でラウンド。通算７アンダーの２０６に伸ばした。

６８をマークした金谷拓実と６９で回った久常涼が通算６アンダーの２２位に浮上した。松山英樹、米沢蓮と細野勇策は通算５アンダーの２９位。石坂友宏は通算３アンダーの４４位に後退。香妻陣一朗は４７位、藤本佳則と中島啓太は５１位、岩崎亜久竜は５７位、岩田寛とアマチュアの長崎煌心は６５位となった。

マイケル・ブレナン、ザック・ボーシュー、ジェーコブ・ブリッジマン（以上米国）が通算１３アンダーの首位で並んだ。２０１３年のマスターズ・トーナメント王者で、２０年以来となるＰＧＡツアーでの優勝を目指すアダム・スコット（オーストラリア）ら５選手が１打差の４位につけている。

ディフェンディングチャンピオンのザンダー・シャウフェレ（米国）は通算９アンダーで、首位とは４打差の１２位。

item.title: ペンシルベニア州で45歳の男が銃撃、妊婦含む8人死亡
item.description: [１０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[１０日 ロイター] - 米ペンシルベニア州エリーで９日に銃撃事件が発生し、妊婦１人と子ども２人を含む８人が死亡した。その後に４５歳の男が自身を撃ったとみられ、死亡した。地元当局が１０日、記者会見で詳細を明らかにした。

当局は容疑者の身元をまだ公表していない。エリー警察のリック・ローラ署長によると、警官が現場に到着する前に自ら銃で撃って死亡したとみられる。

犯行の動機は分かっていない。死亡した９人のうち８人は家族で、１人は家族の友人だったという。

item.title: ＭＬＢ＝ガーディアンズ、2日前に救援のウィリアムズが第5戦で先発
item.description: ［１０日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１０日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）ガーディアンズのギャビン・ウィリアムズ投手（２７）が、１０日に行われるア・リーグ地区シリーズ（５回戦制）、ホワイトソックスとの第５戦に先発登板する。同投手は８日の第４戦にリリーフ登板していた。

ウィリアムズはレギュラーシーズンでは３２試合に先発し、チームトップの１４勝をマーク。救援登板はなかった。

シリーズ第４戦では４点リードの九回途中から８番手として登板し、１８球を投げて１安打無失点。ガーディアンズが９─５で勝利し、最終第５戦に持ち込んだ。ガーディアンズのスティーブン・ボート監督は９日、ウィリアムズは前日のリリーフ登板から順調に回復していると述べていた。

ウィリアムズは５日に行われた第２戦に先発。５回０／３で４安打２失点、１１奪三振の内容で勝敗は付かなかった。ガーディアンズは３─４で負けた。

村上宗隆内野手が所属するホワイトソックスは、第５戦でショーン・バーク投手（２６）が先発する。レギュラーシーズンでの１１勝はチーム最多だった。村上は第５戦に「４番・一塁」で出場する予定。

item.title: Real's Vinicius apologises after red card for hair pull against Villarreal
item.description: Real Madrid's Vinicius Jr has apologised to his teammates and the club's fans after being sent off in the 1-0 win over Villarreal in LaLiga at the Santiago Bernabeu on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Ruairidh Barlow
item.content:encoded: Real Madrid's Vinicius Jr has apologised to his teammates and the club's fans after being sent off in the [USN:L6N45W060 TEXT:"1-0 win over Villarreal"] in LaLiga at the Santiago Bernabeu on Saturday. Vinicius now faces a nervous wait for the ruling of the disciplinary committee, which could see him miss Real's fixture with rivals Barcelona on October 25 at Camp Nou. The Brazilian thought he had scored Real's second goal but his effort was disallowed after a VAR review found he should be dismissed for pulling Nathan Saliba's hair in the build-up. After the match, Vinicius, who came on in the 52nd minute and was red carded 20 minutes later, posted on social media, saying, "sorry to the team and the fans." Spanish Football Federation regulations state that pulling an opponent's hair is regarded as violent conduct. The sanction for violent conduct without causing injury to an opponent (Article 130) is a ban of one to three matches. Real's next three LaLiga games are against Sevilla, Barca and Racing Santander, but missing El Clasico would be a bitter blow for the 26-year-old Brazil international.

item.title: ルビオ米国務長官、日本に「全面的に協力」 沖縄の強盗殺人
item.description: [ワシントン １０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン １０日 ロイター] - ルビオ米国務長官は１０日、沖縄県で日本人女性が殺害された事件を巡り、強盗殺人容疑で米海兵隊員を捜査している日本側に全面的に協力する考えを示した。茂木敏充外相との電話会談後、米国務省が発表した。

国務省によると、ルビオ氏は日本人女性の死亡に哀悼の意を表明。日本政府や地元当局による捜査に「全面的に協力する米国の決意」を伝えた。

日本外務省によると、両外相は「事件の発生防止のために実効性のある措置を取るべく、日米間で協議していくこと」を確認した。

沖縄県警は４日、米軍普天間基地所属のデビン・ジェイコブ・バラード海兵隊上等兵を強盗殺人容疑で逮捕した。バラード容疑者は容疑を否認している。

item.title: Justice Department probes TV networks over Trump pool boycott
item.description: The US Justice Department said on Saturday it is investigating whether television networks violated federal antitrust laws over their decision to boycott covering the White House following its decision to pull the credentials of reporters from three news organizations, including CNN.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The US Justice Department said on Saturday it is investigating whether television networks violated federal antitrust laws over their decision to boycott covering the White House following its decision to pull the credentials of reporters from three news organizations, including CNN. The networks under investigation are ABC, CBS, CNN, NBC and Fox News, the Justice Department said. "Group boycotts among commercial competitors can violate the Sherman Act," a Justice Department spokesperson said. "The Antitrust Division is simply investigating to determine whether these news organizations have violated the antitrust laws." The investigation is the latest in a series of clashes between the Trump administration and major news organizations. President Donald Trump has repeatedly called the mainstream media "fake news" and frequently clashes with reporters during encounters with the press. The action also puts legal and potentially financial pressure on the media to continue coverage of the president even when they disagree with how the White House handles them. The networks did not immediately respond to requests from Reuters for comment. The New York Times was first to report about the probe. The investigation comes after weeks of tension between the White House and the press. CREDENTIALS REVOKED IN SEPTEMBER On September 19, the White House blocked reporters from CNN, Politico, and MS NOW from entering the building, revoking their credentials. The White House said covering the president was a "privilege – not a right.” The outlets sued the administration, alleging the exclusions violated the First Amendment and that the White House was retaliating over their coverage. CNN is one of the five news organizations — along with ABC, CBS, Fox News and NBC — that make up the primary White House television pool. They share the costs of covering the president, take turns organizing coverage and share the footage with outlets around the country. All of the five television networks that cover the White House, including Fox News, suspended coverage in solidarity and refused to provide replacement coverage. The White House reinstated the credentials on September 24 after US District Judge Timothy Kelly ruled that the ban was likely unconstitutional and ordered the administration to "immediately return, reinstate, and restore" their access. However, disputes over access to specific presidential events and pool assignments continued afterward.

item.title: Macklin Celebrini scores in return, but Oilers stifle Sharks
item.description: Tristan Jarry made 19 saves as the Edmonton Oilers skated to a 3-1 win against the host San Jose Sharks on Saturday afternoon.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Tristan Jarry made 19 saves as the Edmonton Oilers skated to a 3-1 win against the host San Jose Sharks on Saturday afternoon. Mattias Ekholm, Vasily Podkolzin and Alex Formenton scored while Connor McDavid increased his early-season points total to 13 with an assist for the Oilers, who have won four straight games since dropping their season opener to the Vancouver Canucks. Macklin Celebrini's first goal of the season was the lone score for the Sharks, who have dropped two of their last three. Celebrini, who missed two games with a lower-body injury, led San Jose with 21:59 of ice time and placed two shots on goal. Yaroslav Askarov made 17 saves. Ekholm put Edmonton up 1-0 at 12:37 of the first period. Isaac Howard set Ekholm up for a slap shot through traffic from between the faceoff circles. San Jose and Edmonton each had five shots on goal in the first frame, while the Sharks out-hit the Oilers 17-7. The Oilers didn't register a shot on goal in the second period until 6:09 remained. Celebrini almost tied the game 1-1 with five seconds left in the frame, but his shot rang off the post. Podkolzin increased Edmonton's lead to 2-0 at 3:13 of the third period. After an Oilers power play expired, McDavid set Podkolzin up with a backward pass and the winger scored on a slap shot. Formenton added to Edmonton's tally with a backhanded shot past Askarov to make the score 3-0 at 5:40. Celebrini put the Sharks on the board 3-1 at 11:19. Michael Misa set up the goal with a backhanded pass from against the boards and Celebrini scored on a wrist shot. --Field Level Media

item.title: US will learn from bruising friendly defeat by Spain, says Hayes
item.description: US women's coach Emma Hayes shook off a dismal 2-0 defeat on Saturday in the first of two friendlies against Spain, with the Americans building towards next month's World Cup qualifiers.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US women's coach Emma Hayes shook off a dismal 2-0 defeat on Saturday in the first of two friendlies against Spain, with the Americans building towards next month's World Cup qualifiers. The match between top-ranked Spain and the Olympic champions was billed as a marquee showdown but the visitors took control as Patri Guijarro and Eva Navarro scored inside 15 minutes. Spain's Adriana Nanclares saved a second-half penalty from Lily Yohannes to keep a clean sheet for the world champions. "When you play the best team in the world you have to execute everything really well in the first instance," said Hayes. "Did I think we did enough to score a goal? Of course we did. Did we do enough to score more than one? Absolutely. "We just didn't make necessarily the right decision and execute with the quality I know we should have." The US had 10 shots on target to three from Spain, who had Athenea Del Castillo sent off in added time for pulling Michelle Cooper's hair three minutes after coming off the bench. Hayes said that efficiency would be a key target for the US when the two sides play again on Tuesday. "We create the most chances in world football. But finishing, we do not do that in world football," Hayes told reporters. "So I wasn't concerned about us creating today, and I'm not concerned about us finishing. You just have to lock in, get the details right, and keep working on it." The US aim to qualify for the 2027 World Cup in Brazil via the Concacaf W Championship, three years after their worst performance at the global tournament where they exited in the last 16 and Spain staked their territory as the world's finest. Briton Hayes' arrival [USN:L8N3C60IU TEXT:"months later"] from Chelsea sparked a renaissance for the US, who collected gold in Paris and welcomed back veteran [USN:L6N45L15G TEXT:"Mallory Swanson"] to camp this month. "We've got some really, really good players and we're a really good team regardless of the result today," said Hayes. "I think we're much closer to them than we were three years ago."

item.title: UCLA QB Nico Iamaleava (leg) leaves game vs. Oregon
item.description: UCLA quarterback Nico Iamaleava suffered an apparent leg injury just before halftime of the No. 21 Bruins' Big Ten Conference game at No. 13 Oregon on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: UCLA quarterback Nico Iamaleava suffered an apparent leg injury just before halftime of the No. 21 Bruins' Big Ten Conference game at No. 13 Oregon on Saturday. Iamaleava did not come out with the UCLA offense on its first drive after intermission. Backup Ty Dieffenbach took over. Iamaleava returned to the sideline in street clothes during the third quarter, signaling the end of his day. Iamaleava committed three turnovers in the first half, including an interception thrown into the end zone on his final play. It was the second pick Iamaleava threw in less than two minutes. He appeared to have suffered the injury on the first one. He got up gingerly with the help of UCLA training staff after taking a hit from Oregon defensive lineman Bear Alexander. Jerry Mixon intercepted Iamaleava's under-duress throw. Iamaleava finished 10-for-17 passing for 162 yards, no touchdowns and the two interceptions. He also lost a fumble inside the Bruins' 10, which led to an Oregon touchdown, in the first quarter. --Field Level Media

item.title: Patriots place WR Mack Hollins (calf) on injured reserve
item.description: The New England Patriots placed leading receiver Mack Hollins on injured reserve Saturday due to a calf injury.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The New England Patriots placed leading receiver Mack Hollins on injured reserve Saturday due to a calf injury. Hollins is required to miss at least four games. He leads New England in receptions (15) and receiving yardage (209). Hollins, 33, was injured during the third quarter of last week's 29-26 victory over the Buffalo Bills. The injury to Hollins comes with A.J. Brown (ankle) already on the injured list. New England's receivers group against the visiting Las Vegas Raiders on Sunday will consist of Romeo Doubs, DeMario Douglas, Efton Chism III and Kyle Williams. The Patriots also placed fullback Reggie Gilliam (ankle/knee) on IR. New England also activated special teams standout Brenden Schooler (back) from the non-football injured list, signed cornerback Kindle Vildor to the 53-man roster and elevated linebacker K.J. Britt and safety Elliott Davison from the practice squad for Sunday's game. --Field Level Media

item.title: Top 25 roundup: Oklahoma stuns No. 1 Texas on walk-off field goal
item.description: Tate Sandell hit a 47-yard field goal with no time left on the clock to give Oklahoma a 27-24 upset of No. 1 Texas on Saturday in Dallas.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Tate Sandell hit a 47-yard field goal with no time left on the clock to give Oklahoma a 27-24 upset of No. 1 Texas on Saturday in Dallas. Courtland Guillory intercepted Arch Manning at the Oklahoma 39 with 19 seconds left in regulation to give the Sooners (3-2, 1-1 Southeastern Conference) a shot. Completions of 13 and 20 yards from John Mateer to Isaiah Sategna gave Sandell the chance to win it. The win was Oklahoma's first over the Longhorns (4-1, 1-1 SEC) since 2023 and its first over a top-ranked opponent since beating Missouri in the 2007 Big 12 Championship Game. Oklahoma had never before beaten a No. 1 opponent when unranked. Manning finished 19 of 31 for 260 yards and three touchdowns, but he also threw two interceptions that helped sink the Longhorns, who outgained the Sooners 382-238. No. 2 Georgia 20, No. 6 Alabama 17 Gunner Stockton threw for 249 yards and a touchdown while rushing for another score to help the Bulldogs earn a victory over the Crimson Tide in Tuscaloosa, Ala. Dwight Phillips Jr. rushed for a career-high 120 yards for Georgia (6-0, 4-0 SEC), which posted its first regular-season win over Alabama since 2007 -- also the last victory for the Bulldogs in Tuscaloosa. Peyton Woodring's 23-yard field goal with 5:25 left proved to be the game-winning play. Keelon Russell completed 16 of 30 passes for 185 yards and a touchdown for Alabama (5-1, 3-1), which was outgained 455-346 and trailed 10-0 before jumping ahead 14-10 at halftime on EJ Crowell's 1-yard TD run on the final play of the first half. No. 3 Notre Dame 58, Stanford 7 Jonaz Walton rushed for 181 yards and two touchdowns, including a 97-yard scoring run, and the host Fighting Irish pummeled the Cardinal in South Bend, Ind. CJ Carr completed 14 of 20 passes for 181 yards and three touchdowns for Notre Dame (6-0), which never trailed. Nolan James Jr. rushed for 73 yards and two scores. Davis Warren completed 12 of 22 passes for 144 yards with one touchdown and one interception for Stanford (2-4), which was outgained 598-202, including 361-58 on the ground. No. 5 Ohio State 45, Maryland 16 Julian Sayin threw four first-half touchdown passes, two to Jeremiah Smith, and the Buckeyes rolled past the Terrapins in Columbus, Ohio. Sayin passed for 203 yards in the first 30 minutes as the Buckeyes (5-1, 3-0 Big Ten) took a 31-10 halftime lead. Smith's first TD, the 37th of his career, tied Michigan's Anthony Carter for second all-time in the Big Ten. The second one moved Smith one behind record-holder Braylon Edwards of Michigan. Bo Jackson ran for 107 yards and two second-half touchdowns to ice the game. Maryland used a 52-yard pick-six by Daniel Wingate to pull Maryland (2-4, 0-3) within 31-16 with 5:12 left in the third quarter. Maryland QB Malik Washington completed 12 of 25 passes for 64 yards. No. 7 Indiana 20, Nebraska 17 Josh Hoover hit Nick Marsh for two long touchdown passes and rallied the Hoosiers to a Big Ten victory over the Cornhuskers in Lincoln, Neb. Hoover completed 12 of 22 passes for 263 yards and two scores as the Hoosiers (6-0, 3-0) shrugged off their first deficit of the season to extend their winning streak to 22 games heading into next week's home showdown against Ohio State. Nebraska limited the nation's No. 9 rushing offense to 65 yards -- far below the Hoosiers' 252.6-yard average. Anthony Colandrea, whose 39-yard touchdown keeper gave Nebraska a 17-6 lead with 12:01 to go, finished with 263 passing yards and 47 rushing yards as the Huskers (5-1, 2-1) came up short against a Top 25 foe for the 31st consecutive time. No. 9 Ole Miss 52, Vanderbilt 17 Trinidad Chambliss threw three touchdown passes and the Rebels scored four touchdowns in a nine-minute span of the second quarter in a rout of the host Commodores in Nashville, Tenn. Chambliss completed 20 of 30 passes for 213 yards with an interception. He also accounted for a rushing touchdown. Deuce Alexander caught a 39-yard touchdown pass and Shekai Mills-Knight produced a touchdown run of 35 yards for Ole Miss (4-1, 2-1). Jared Curtis returned from a one-week absence due to a knee injury to pass for 222 yards and a touchdown for Vanderbilt (3-3, 0-3), but he also committed three turnovers, two of which led to touchdowns during the second-quarter blitz. Kentucky 35, No. 10 LSU 34 (OT) Kenny Minchey drove the Wildcats to a tying field goal at the end of regulation and ran in the decisive two-point conversion in overtime as they defeated the Tigers in SEC play in Lexington, Ky. CJ Baxter rushed for 123 yards and two touchdowns, Minchey passed for 246 yards and the Wildcats (5-1, 3-1) won by the same score on a two-point overtime conversion as they did the previous Saturday at South Carolina. Sam Leavitt passed for 275 yards, two touchdowns and one interception, Jackson Harris caught one of those scoring passes and tossed one of his own for LSU (4-2, 1-2). No. 12 Utah 41, Kansas 24 Wayshawn Parker ran for 171 yards and two touchdowns to lead the Utes to a victory over the Jayhawks in Salt Lake City. It marked Parker's second straight game with more than 170 rushing yards after he posted a career-high 174 yards on the ground in Utah's win at Iowa State on Sept. 26. Devon Dampier completed 23 of 30 passes for 238 yards and three touchdowns to help the Utes (5-0, 2-0 Big 12) keep their record unblemished. Dampier added 68 yards and a score on the ground. Ricky Johnson led the Utah receivers with a season-high 104 yards and a touchdown on five catches. Isaiah Marshall was 19 of 37 for 333 passing yards and two touchdowns to lead Kansas. Cam Pickett, in his third game, tallied a season-high 134 yards on eight catches for the Jayhawks (2-3, 0-2), who outscored the Utes 17-7 in the second quarter to cut the halftime deficit to 21-17 and trailed 27-24 late in the third quarter. No. 21 UCLA 17, No. 13 Oregon 15 Wayne Knight rushed for a touchdown and caught another while the Bruins' defense stuffed a late two-point conversion attempt to earn a Big Ten win over the Ducks in Eugene, Ore. UCLA (5-0, 3-0 Big Ten) had not won in Autzen Stadium since 2004, but Knight's 9-yard score off a Ty Dieffenbach pass in the third quarter gave the Bruins a 17-6 lead that proved to be enough of a cushion to snap their eight-game losing streak on Oregon's field. Knight finished with 22 carries for 103 yards and caught three passes for 12 yards. Oregon (3-2, 1-1) battled back in the fourth quarter after Brock Thomas replaced quarterback Dylan Raiola, who started in place of injured Dante Moore. Thomas hit 11 of 15 passes for 156 yards, which included a 44-yard touchdown strike to Evan Stewart that pulled the Ducks within two with 2:16 to go. After a facemask penalty gave Oregon another chance from the 1-yard line, UCLA's Tyson Ford stuffed Jordon Davison's rush on the subsequent attempt. No. 14 Missouri 27, Texas A&M 6 Jamal Roberts rushed for 222 yards and two touchdowns, and the Tigers kept the Aggies out of the end zone in the SEC victory at Columbia, Mo. Roberts had 211 rushing yards a week ago against then-No. 8 Florida. On Saturday, Missouri (5-1, 2-1) intercepted Marcel Reed twice, getting one pick apiece from Trajen Greco and Elijah Dotson. The Tigers allowed 216 total yards, including only 29 on the ground. Texas A&M (3-3, 1-3), which has lost three of its past four games, trailed 10-3 at halftime and played effectively on defense until the second half, when Roberts and the Mizzou running game appeared to grind down the Aggies. Reed finished 19-of-39 passing for 187 yards. No. 15 Tennessee 24, Arkansas 17 DeSean Bishop's 8-yard touchdown run with 1:57 remaining led the Volunteers past the Razorbacks in Fayetteville, Ark., for Tennessee's first road win against Arkansas since 2001. Bishop had 19 carries for 138 yards and George MacIntyre was 18-for-29 passing for 247 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions in his first start for the Volunteers (5-1, 2-1 SEC) as he replaced injured true freshman Faizon Brandon. KJ Jackson completed 15 of 27 passes for 155 yards with one touchdown for Arkansas (5-1, 2-1). Cam Settles led a balanced Razorback running game with 50 of the team's 133 rushing yards. South Carolina 38, No. 16 Florida 19 Quarterback LaNorris Sellers fired four touchdown passes and rushed for a score as the Gamecocks broke a three-game losing streak with an upset of the Gators in Gainesville, Fla. After blowing a 17-point lead in a home overtime loss last week against Kentucky, the Gamecocks (3-3, 1-3 SEC) snapped an eight-game conference losing streak as Sellers went 23 of 35 for 279 yards, with no interceptions. Nyck Harbor had 83 receiving yards and a touchdown on four catches. The Gators (4-2, 2-2) lost their second straight game as Aaron Philo was 21 of 28 for 227 yards and a touchdown, with one interception. Bailey Stockton had 127 yards and a score on eight receptions. Florida's Jadan Baugh (15 carries, 59 yards) scored his NCAA-best 12th rushing touchdown of the season in the fourth quarter. No. 18 Oklahoma State 42, UCF 28, Drew Mestemaker threw for 304 yards and two touchdowns and rushed for a third as the Cowboys pulled away in the fourth quarter for the Big 12 triumph in Stillwater, Okla. With Oklahoma State (4-1, 2-0) clinging to a 27-21 edge early in the fourth quarter, Evan Jackson returned a deflected backward pass 28 yards for a touchdown to give the Cowboys a 35-21 lead with 10:32 to go. After Oklahoma State stuffed a fourth-and-1 play, Mestemaker hit Wyatt Young for a 5-yard score to break it open. Keyone Jenkins completed 30 of 42 passes for 265 yards and four touchdowns for UCF (3-3, 1-2). Josh Derry caught 11 passes for 84 yards and one score while Caden Piening added seven receptions for 60 yards and a score. No. 19 USC 31, Penn State 23 Jayden Maiava passed for 301 yards and three touchdowns as the Trojans handed the Nittany Lions a third straight conference loss with a win in University Park, Pa. Maiava threw a TD pass to Trent Mosley (nine catches, 111 yards), who had missed the previous three games, and also connected on scoring passes to Tanook Hines and Kayden Dixon-Wyatt. King Miller took care of matters on the ground for the Trojans (6-1, 3-1 Big Ten), rushing for 102 yards and a touchdown on 19 carries. Rocco Becht threw for 289 yards and a score for Penn State (3-3, 0-3). The Nittany Lions' rushing attack totaled just 68 yards on 31 attempts in front of a whiteout crowd of 114,419. No. 22 Houston 35, Kansas State 16 Conner Weigman threw for 242 yards and four touchdowns, all to Patrick Overmyer, as the Cougars cruised to a victory over the Wildcats in a Big 12 game in Manhattan, Kan. Overmyer caught eight passes for 83 yards, including touchdowns of 1, 2, 8 and 2 yards. Makhi Hughes rushed for 78 yards and a score, and Re'Shaun Sanford II added 90 yards on the ground for Houston (5-1, 2-1 Big 12), which led 28-3 early in the third quarter. For the Wildcats (3-2, 0-2), Avery Johnson completed 16 of 30 passes for 182 yards, two touchdowns and one interception. Garrett Oakley and Jaron Tibbs each caught a touchdown pass. No. 23 Boise State 38, Fresno State 31 Dylan Riley recorded 214 scrimmage yards and accounted for two touchdowns as the Broncos won their fifth consecutive game by topping the Bulldogs in Pac-12 play at Fresno, Calif. Riley entered the day as the national leader in rushing yards and he gained 150 on the ground to raise his total to 835 and added 64 yards on four receptions. Riley scored on a 72-yard run and a 44-yard pass play. Maddux Madsen completed 23 of 34 passes for 238 yards and two touchdowns for Boise State (5-1, 2-0 Pac 12), which had lost its previous three meetings with Fresno State. Sire Gaines rushed for 120 yards and a touchdown. Jayden Mandal was 19-of-33 passing for 218 yards and two touchdowns and also rushed for a score for the Bulldogs (4-2, 1-1), who had a four-game winning streak halted. Ezekiel Avit caught six passes for 96 yards and two touchdowns -- one from Khristian Martin -- and Gavin Correia also had a scoring reception. North Carolina 21, No. 25 Pitt 17 Billy Edwards Jr. threw for two touchdowns as the Tar Heels recorded the upset of the Panthers in an Atlantic Coast Conference game in Pittsburgh, giving second-year coach Bill Belichick his first victory against a ranked team. Edwards completed 18 of 26 passes for 249 yards and two interceptions. The Tar Heels' (3-2, 1-1 Atlantic Coast Conference) go-ahead touchdown came on Edwards' 75-yard touchdown pass play to Shamar Easter with 12:36 remaining in the game. La'Vell Wright ran for two touchdowns for Pitt (5-1, 2-1). Holden Geriner was 27-for-44 passing for 219 yards, with two interceptions, in his first start following a season-ending knee injury suffered by Mason Heintschel a week earlier. --Field Level Media

item.title: Nico Hischier scores milestone goal, leads Devils past Canucks
item.description: Nico Hischier scored twice on the power play, including his 200th career goal, and the New Jersey Devils rallied to beat the Vancouver Canucks 4-1 on Saturday afternoon in Newark, N.J.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Nico Hischier scored twice on the power play, including his 200th career goal, and the New Jersey Devils rallied to beat the Vancouver Canucks 4-1 on Saturday afternoon in Newark, N.J. Jake Allen made 20 saves in his 500th career game to get the win as New Jersey snapped a two-game losing skid. Jesper Bratt had a goal and an assist, Jesper Boqvist also scored and Jack Hughes had two assists for the Devils, who finished with three goals on the power play to claim their second win of the season. Hischier, who signed a five-year, $58.5 million deal in the offseason, also had an assist. Linus Karlsson had a goal while Leevi Merilainen and Kevin Lankinen combined to stop 33 shots for the Canucks, who suffered their third consecutive loss. Paul Cotter, the NHL's Third Star of the Week, was held pointless in his first game with the Canucks against his former team. The teams traded power-play goals to open the scoring in the first period. Karlsson gave the Canucks a 1-0 lead with a power play goal on a one-timer after taking a pass from Brock Boeser. Hischier busted out of an early slump to score his first point of the season and 200th goal to tie it 1-1 with Vancouver forward Jonathan Lekkerimaki off for high-sticking. The Devils then recorded their first regulation lead of the season by capitalizing on a Canucks miscue in the Vancouver zone. Amadeus Lombardi stole the puck from Canucks defenseman Filip Hronek, then took a shot that generated a rebound which was poked in by forward Boqvist to make it 2-1 at 16:24 of the first period. Boqvist's goal came against Lankinen, who entered the game after starter Merilainen sustained an equipment malfunction when his skate blade fell out. Merilainen left the game with 5:27 remaining in the first and returned for the start of the second period. Bratt took advantage of a mad scramble in the Canucks' crease early in the second, scoring on the power play from a sharp angle with a shot that ricocheted off a couple Vancouver players into the net to give the Devils a two-goal lead. Hischier finished off a tic-tac-toe passing play for his second power play goal with just 10 seconds left in the second to make it 4-1. --Field Level Media

item.title: Une nouvelle attaque contre l'aéroport de Ryad fait douze morts, selon des sources
item.description: Une attaque contre l'aéroport de Ryad a fait douze morts et des dizaines de blessés samedi, selon trois sources au fait du dossier, tandis que tous les vols ont été déroutés.
item.dc:creator: Timour Azhari, Enas Alashray
item.content:encoded: Une attaque contre l'aéroport de Ryad a fait douze morts et des dizaines de blessés samedi, selon trois sources au fait du dossier, tandis que tous les vols ont été déroutés. Cette attaque n'a pas été revendiquée dans l'immédiat mais elle intervient dans le contexte d'une intensification des frappes de missiles menées par les Houthis du Yémen, alliés de l'Iran, contre l'Arabie saoudite. L'aéroport de Ryad a déjà été visé à deux reprises la semaine passée par des attaques qui ont fait quatre morts et plusieurs blessés, endommageant également un avion de la compagnie Saudia. Le bureau des médias du gouvernement saoudien n'a pas répondu dans l'immédiat aux demandes de commentaires relatives à celle de samedi, pour laquelle le système d'alerte précoce n'a émis aucun avertissement. Aucun bilan officiel n'a été fourni. Les sources, dont deux sont des responsables occidentaux, ont prévenu que le nombre de victimes pourrait encore changer. Les blessés, dont certains sont dans un état grave, ont été transportés à l'hôpital, ont-elles indiqué. Un témoin présent à l'aéroport a dit avoir vu une explosion puis de nombreuses personnes blessées allongées au sol à l'intérieur de l'aéroport. Plus d'une douzaine d'ambulances ont été vues en train de se diriger à vive allure vers les lieux de l'attaque. Un voyageur blessé a pour sa part indiqué à Reuters avoir vu un objet traverser le ciel à l'extérieur de l'aéroport avant qu'une partie du plafond, près d'une porte d'embarquement, ne s'effondre. Le président américain Donald Trump, interrogé par des journalistes à la Maison blanche sur une éventuelle participation des États-Unis à des frappes saoudiennes contre les Houthis, a par la suite déclaré : "C'est possible. Nous allons examiner cette question. Nous venons juste d'apprendre cette récente attaque, nous prendrons donc une décision. Nous agissons très rapidement." L'ambassade des États-Unis à Ryad a indiqué être "au courant des attaques" et a "vivement recommandé à tous les citoyens américains d'éviter cet aéroport et les zones environnantes". "INCIDENT GRAVE" Les ambassades du Royaume-Uni et d'Irlande en Arabie saoudite ont de leur côté déclaré sur X qu'elles étaient également informées d'un "incident grave", tandis que celle du Canada a indiqué que des "activités militaires en cours" perturbaient les opérations aéroportuaires. Selon le site de suivi du trafic aérien Flightradar24, tous les vols à destination de Ryad ont été soit déroutés, soit annulés. Kuwait Airways a indiqué avoir annulé ses vols à destination et en provenance de la capitale saoudienne, invoquant une fermeture de l'aéroport de Ryad due à la "situation sécuritaire". Etihad Airways et Qatar Airways avaient auparavant annulé plusieurs vols entre leurs hubs respectifs et Ryad, certaines annulations étant maintenues jusqu'à lundi. Les assauts houthistes de la semaine passée avaient déjà conduit plusieurs compagnies aériennes à suspendre ou à annuler leurs liaisons vers la capitale saoudienne, peu avant la tenue à Ryad d'importantes conférences consacrées à l'énergie et à l'investissement. Les organisateurs de ces conférences ont indiqué samedi qu'elles se dérouleraient comme prévu et tenté de rassurer les participants quant à leur sécurité. Les Houthis ont déclaré que les compagnies aériennes devaient éviter l'espace aérien saoudien, qu'ils ont qualifié de zone d'opérations militaires après le lancement, plus tôt ce mois-ci, d'une offensive contre le groupe par le gouvernement yéménite soutenu par l'Arabie saoudite.

item.title: Inter rout Parma, De Bruyne double lifts Napoli
item.description: Inter Milan maintained their strong start to the Serie A campaign with a comfortable 3-0 home victory over Parma on Saturday, while two goals from Kevin De Bruyne eased Napoli to a 3-0 home win against Frosinone following the international break.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Inter Milan maintained their strong start to the Serie A campaign with a comfortable 3-0 home victory over Parma on Saturday, while two goals from Kevin De Bruyne eased Napoli to a 3-0 home win against Frosinone following the international break. First-half goals from Petar Sucic, Hakan Calhanoglu, who converted a penalty, and Marcus Thuram put the champions firmly in control inside the opening 31 minutes. The result lifted leaders Inter to 16 points from six matches. “After a three-week break, we didn’t know how things would go. We’ve worked well during this period, the players have trained well. I’m happy,” Inter head coach Cristian Chivu told DAZN. The defeat marked a difficult first game in charge for Parma coach Alberto Gilardino, [USN:L6N45L0WD TEXT:"who succeeded"] Carlos Cuesta following his departure in late September. “I think you always have to be clear-headed at different moments of the game, depending on who you’re playing against and what you’re up against. The overall picture tonight is that Parma started well, but when you are naive, you pay the price,” Gilardino said. MCTOMINAY RETURNS FOR NAPOLI In Naples, Scott McTominay was named among the substitutes after recovering from a heart problem as Napoli overcame a sluggish start to beat Frosinone. Napoli were awarded a penalty in the 29th minute and after Rasmus Hojlund's spot kick was saved by Lorenzo Palmisani, the effort was ordered to be retaken as the goalkeeper was ruled to have moved off his line. Kevin De Bruyne converted the second attempt before Noa Lang doubled Napoli's lead three minutes later. McTominay made his return just after the hour mark to a standing ovation from the home crowd, although he was unable to influence the contest. De Bruyne wrapped up the victory late on, finishing from close range for his second goal of the evening. The win provided a much needed boost to Napoli as they had suffered two defeats and a draw in their previous five matches. They moved to sixth place with 10 points. "We had to win," De Bruyne told Sky. "It's a very difficult schedule, but we have to move forward and do our best." Second placed AS Roma and Lazio, who are both on 13 points, will be in action on Sunday. Roma visit Como, while Lazio host Monza. Surprise package Cagliari, fourth on 12 points, face a tough home test against Juventus on Sunday.

item.title: PSG beat Le Mans 3-1 as Monaco stay top despite draw
item.description: Paris St Germain's Maghnes Akliouche scored his first goal for the club as the champions eased to a 3-1 home victory over Le Mans in Ligue 1 on Saturday, while league leaders AS Monaco were held to a frustrating 2-2 draw by visiting Toulouse.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Paris St Germain's Maghnes Akliouche scored his first goal for the club as the champions eased to a 3-1 home victory over Le Mans in Ligue 1 on Saturday, while league leaders AS Monaco were held to a frustrating 2-2 draw by visiting Toulouse. The game was played in a tense atmosphere as, amid student protests across France, a banner was unfurled at the stadium which read: "Your riot police repress, our youth resists." Scuffles broke out as police tried to remove the banner and eventually the entire stand was temporarily emptied of spectators. PSG took the lead with a penalty converted by Lucas Beraldo, but Le Mans levelled in the second half through Louis Mafouta who blasted home for his fourth Ligue 1 goal this season. Home coach Luis Enrique reacted by making four substitutions at once just before the hour mark and one of those, Khvicha Kvaratskhelia, fired them ahead two minutes after coming on as he reacted quickest to a rebound. Akliouche then ended the game as a contest with the third, his first goal since switching from Monaco at the start of the season. PSG were awarded a penalty in added time but Desire Doue’s effort was saved by goalkeeper Nicolas Kocik. The win leaves PSG in fifth on 11 points after six games. Monaco let a 2-0 first-half lead slip as they were held by Toulouse. They have 14 points and a one-point lead over Lille. Edan Diop scored their opener and then turned provider for Matthis Abline to net his first Monaco goal since a move from Nantes. Casper Tengstedt pulled one back for the visitors with a penalty just after the break before teenager Sion Oppong netted his first Toulouse goal to make it 2-2. Lille briefly moved top as they won 1-0 at home to 10-man Le Havre before being leapfrogged later on by Monaco. Dilane Bakwa scored the winner in the fifth minute but Lille were run close by Le Havre, who lost Ayumu Seko to a red card for a professional foul just past the hour mark. Paris FC remain fourth despite a 1-0 loss at Lorient and sit above local rivals PSG on goal difference. They had more of the ball but Lorient took their chance as Gabin Bernardeau netted after 68 minutes. Brest scored four first-half goals before eventually running out 5-1 victors over 10-man Angers in a one-sided contest. Ludovic Ajorque, Lucas Tousart, Kenny Lala, Mama Balde and Pathe Mboup scored for Brest, while Prosper Peter netted a consolation for the visitors, who had Jordan Lefort sent off after 59 minutes.

item.title: Un tiroteo masivo deja nueve muertos en Erie, en Estados Unidos
item.description: Las autoridades confirmaron la muerte de nueve personas en Erie, en el estado de Pensilvania, en Estados Unidos, tras lo que el gobernador Josh Shapiro calificó como un "trágico tiroteo masivo".
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Las autoridades confirmaron la muerte de nueve personas en Erie, en el estado de Pensilvania, en Estados Unidos, tras lo que el gobernador Josh Shapiro calificó como un "trágico tiroteo masivo". El incidente tuvo lugar a última hora del viernes y los investigadores determinaron que todas las muertes ocurrieron antes de que los agentes llegaran al lugar de los hechos, según un comunicado del Ayuntamiento de Erie el sábado. "He hablado con la alcaldesa Devlin y le he ofrecido todo el apoyo de mi gobierno tras el trágico tiroteo masivo ocurrido anoche en Erie, en el que perdieron la vida nueve de nuestros conciudadanos de Pensilvania", escribió Shapiro en una publicación del sábado por la mañana en X, refiriéndose a la alcaldesa Daria Devlin. El jefe de policía de Erie, Rick Lorah, dijo en un comunicado tras el tiroteo que la escena era una de las más difíciles a las que se había enfrentado durante su gestion. "La pérdida de vidas humanas es devastadora, y las circunstancias a las que nos enfrentamos son profundamente inquietantes", agregó. Lorah añadió que las autoridades seguían trabajando para determinar el motivo. El ayuntamiento indicó que estaba prevista una rueda de prensa para el sábado.

item.title: サウジの空港に再び攻撃、12人死亡・300人超負傷 フーシ派が閉鎖表明
item.description:
Timour Azhari Enas Alashray
［リヤド １０日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Timour Azhari　Enas Alashray

［リヤド　１０日　ロイター］ - サウジアラビアのリヤドにあるキング・ハーリド国際空港が１０日に攻撃を受け、同国当局によると、少なくとも１２人が死亡、３００人以上が負傷した。イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派が攻撃を認めた。同空港が攻撃されるのは今週３回目。サウジへの攻撃は一段と激しさを増している。

サウジ民間航空当局によると、死者はサウジアラビア人４人、バングラデシュ人２人のほか、米国、ヨルダン、パレスチナ、シリア、スーダン、エジプトの出身者各１人。負傷者は最新の集計で３０９人まで増えた。事情を知る関係者によると、負傷者は救急車やヘリコプターで搬送され、病院は対応に追われた。一部は重体という。

今回の攻撃は事前の警告なく発生し、早期警戒システムの警報も出ていなかった。同空港は今週既に２度攻撃を受け、４人が死亡したほか、駐機中のサウジの民間旅客機が大きく損傷した。相次ぐ攻撃で多数の死者が出たことで、サウジの防衛能力の脆弱性が浮き彫りとなった。

フーシ派の広報部門トップは攻撃後にＸへ投稿し、「リヤド国際空港を閉鎖した」と表明した。フーシ派は、サウジの支援を受けるイエメン政府が５日にフーシ派への攻勢を開始したことを受け、サウジ領空を軍事作戦区域に指定し、民間航空機に同領空を避けるよう警告している。

サウジ主導のアラブ諸国連合軍は今回の攻撃に報復すると表明した。

２０１５年にイエメン内戦に介入したサウジは、フーシ派と地上戦を展開するイエメン政府を支援するため、フーシ派への空爆を続けている。サウジとイエメン政府は、フーシ派支配地域の標的に数百回の攻撃を行ったとしている。フーシ派は、これらの攻撃で女性や子どもを含む民間人が死亡したとしている。ロイターは双方の主張を独自に確認できていない。

今回の攻撃後、トランプ米大統領はホワイトハウスの外で記者団の取材に応じた。米国がサウジによるフーシ派への攻撃に加わる計画があるかと問われ、「そうするかもしれない。検討する。今回の攻撃について知ったばかりだ。決定を下すことになる。われわれは非常に迅速に動く」と述べた。

ルビオ米国務長官は攻撃を非難し、「罪のない民間人の命をあからさまに軽視する行為だ」と述べた。

在リヤド米大使館は「攻撃を把握している」とし、「全ての米国民に対し、同空港と周辺地域を避けるよう強く勧告する」と表明した。在サウジの英国大使館とアイルランド大使館もＸへの投稿で、同空港での「重大な事案」を把握していると明らかにした。カナダ大使館は「進行中の軍事活動」が空港の運営に影響を及ぼしていると説明した。

空港にいた目撃者によると、爆発が起き、その後、屋内で複数の人が負傷して倒れていた。負傷した旅行者はロイターに対し、空港の外で何かが上空を飛んでいくのを見た後、出発ゲート付近の天井の一部が崩落したと語った。

＜リヤドで大型国際会議＞

サウジ民間航空当局によると、リヤドに向かう全便が目的地を変更し、空港の業務は一時停止した。

航空機追跡サイト「フライトレーダー２４」によると、リヤド行きの全便が目的地変更か欠航となった。エティハド航空とカタール航空は、それぞれの拠点空港とリヤドを結ぶ複数の便を欠航にした。一部の欠航は１２日まで続く。クウェート航空も、リヤド空港が「治安情勢」を理由に閉鎖されたとして、リヤド発着便を欠航にしたと発表した。

リヤドでは今月、世界石油会議（ＷＰＣ）とサウジアラビアの政府系ファンド、パブリック・インベストメント・ファンド（ＰＩＦ）が主導する国際金融会議 「未来投資イニシアチブ（ＦＩＩ）」が開かれる。両会議の主催者は１０日、予定通り開催すると表明し、参加者の安全への懸念払拭に努めた

item.title: Bruins score 3 goals in final period, keep Flyers winless
item.description: Capping a three-point effort, Fraser Minten's second goal of the season concluded a three-goal third period for the Boston Bruins in a 5-1 win over the visiting Philadelphia Flyers on Saturday afternoon.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Capping a three-point effort, Fraser Minten's second goal of the season concluded a three-goal third period for the Boston Bruins in a 5-1 win over the visiting Philadelphia Flyers on Saturday afternoon. Pavel Zacha and Mason Lohrei scored to give Boston leads after the first two periods before the emphatic finish. Marat Khusnutdinov and Casey Mittelstadt also lit the lamp, while Minten and JJ Peterka each had two assists. Jeremy Swayman made 14 saves en route to the Bruins' second straight win and fourth through their first six games. Boston finished with a 32-15 shots on goal advantage. Porter Martone scored a power-play goal and Dan Vladar (27 saves) took the loss for Philadelphia, which remains winless at 0-4-2 on the season. The Flyers were missing forward Travis Konecny (lower-body) and defenseman Cam York (upper-body) due to day-to-day injuries. Zacha's first goal of the season at the 12:24 mark punctuated a dominant opening period in which Boston held a 12-3 edge in shots, including holding Philadelphia without a chance during its first power play. Less than one minute after the Bruins completed a solid kill, David Pastrnak moved into the zone off a turnover at the blue line and dropped a backhand pass for Zacha, whose shot from the high slot leaked through Vladar and dribbled over the goal line for the opening tally. The visitors went without a shot for more than half of the second period, but Swayman stood up to the task of Martone's driving backhander with 9:51 to go. Lohrei doubled Boston's lead with 2:48 left in the middle frame. After Swayman's save on a David Jiricek point shot created an odd-man rush, Minten started the play and Peterka fed the trailing defenseman for a top-shelf wrister coming to the top of the circles. The Bruins needed only 1:55 of third-period time to make it a 3-0 game, as Khusnutdinov slammed home Minten's pass from behind the net following a crisp sequence between the duo and defenseman Will Borgen. Martone broke the shutout at 6:32, placing a tight-angle wrister from the left circle upstairs on Swayman. At 9:21, Boston regained its three-goal advantage after Casey Mittelstadt joined Lohrei with his second goal in as many games. After James Hagens had an initial shot saved by Vladar, he made a diagonal pass to Elias Lindholm in the bottom of the right circle, and Mittelstadt buried it in front. Minten put the exclamation point on the victory with 4:01 to go, speeding past a defender and down the left side to slip a quick shot five-hole on Vladar. --Field Level Media

item.title: Spurs show fight as United's struggles deepen at Old Trafford
item.description: While Tottenham Hotspur have plenty to rue amid a difficult opening to the season, manager Roberto De Zerbi saw something at Old Trafford on Saturday that gave him reason to believe his struggling side may finally be turning a corner.
item.dc:creator: Lori Ewing
item.content:encoded: While Tottenham Hotspur have plenty to rue amid a difficult opening to the season, manager Roberto De Zerbi saw something at Old Trafford on Saturday that gave him reason to believe his struggling side may finally be turning a corner. Spurs are 18th and without a victory after six Premier League games following Saturday's 1-1 draw at Manchester United, yet De Zerbi was heartened by the fight his team showed to thoroughly dominate the game and then snatch a stoppage-time equaliser through Dominic Solanke despite being reduced to 10 men. "I am very happy because I have seen the right spirit and character," De Zerbi told Sky Sports. Bryan Mbeumo scored against the run of play before Tottenham's Rodrigo Bentancur was sent off for head-butting Luke Shaw, leaving United fans daring to dream of a much-needed victory, only for Solanke's 92nd-minute header to puncture the mood at Old Trafford. "We suffered in the game. I like the situation we were in with the red card. We need this situation. We have not accepted the defeat. We have to react in all ways we can," De Zerbi said. Rather than fold, Tottenham fought until Solanke headed the equaliser in stoppage time, giving De Zerbi's side more to celebrate than their hosts despite their lowly league position. Spurs, who spent more than £300 million ($397 million) in the transfer market during the close season, have failed to win any of their opening six league matches for only the fourth time in the club's history. Their manager, however, believes there were signs against United that his ideas are beginning to take hold. "We have to believe in ourselves and this football way," De Zerbi said. "If we believe, improve and play as a team, we will score many goals and win many games. If we don't play as a team, it is impossible." For United, there was less cause for optimism. Michael Carrick's side have collected only six points from their first six games, their poorest start to a league campaign since 1986-87, when they had four at the same stage. United struggled desperately before taking the lead through Mbeumo. But even with a man advantage, they failed to put away a Tottenham team that had started the day bottom of the table. "We were mixed (in performance)," Carrick said. "We found it tough first half, it was a challenging first half for us and you could see it just wasn't quite there, it wasn't clicking." The Reds are also winless in the last three league matches when their opponent has had a red card. Carrick was particularly frustrated at allowing Tottenham back into the game that appeared to be United's for the taking. "It's a game we should kill off. And we didn't," he said. "Very disappointed to be in a position like that and not come away with the game." ($1 = 0.7558 pounds)

item.title: 茂木外相がルビオ米国務長官と電話会談、ＩＣＣ制裁で「意思疎通を継続」
item.description:
Tamiyuki Kihara
［東京／ワシントン １０日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Tamiyuki Kihara

［東京／ワシントン　１０日　ロイター］ - 茂木敏充外相は１０日夜、米国のルビオ国務長官と電話会談し、トランプ米政権が国際刑事裁判所（ＩＣＣ）本体に制裁措置を科したことについて、緊密に意思疎通を継続することで一致した。茂木氏はこれに先立ち、ＩＣＣの赤根智子所長とも電話で会談した。

日本外務省によると、茂木氏はＩＣＣについてルビオ氏に「これまで表明している日本の立場」（外務省関係者）を改めて伝達。両氏は緊密に意思疎通を継続していくことで一致した。厳しい安全保障環境の中で日米同盟をさらに強固なものにし、幅広く協力を進めていくために引き続き取り組むことも確認した。

このほか、沖縄県で発生した強盗殺人事件で米兵が逮捕されたことについても「事件の発生防止のために実効性のある措置を取るべく、日米間で協議していくこと」を確認した。赤根氏との電話会談では、ＩＣＣを巡る現下の状況などについて意見交換したという。

米国務省は声明で、日米外相が電話会談で、ＩＣＣへの制裁や３０─３１日に米アトランタで開催される２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）外相会合などについて意見交換したと発表した。沖縄県で発生した強盗殺人事件については、 「ルビオ氏は沖縄での日本国民の死去に心からの哀悼の意を示すとともに、日本政府と地元当局が捜査を進めるに当たり、連絡を取り合い全面的に協力するという米国の決意を伝えた」とした。

日本や英国など複数の欧州諸国、カナダの外相は９日、トランプ米政権がＩＣＣ本体に制裁措置を科したことを受け、「制裁が実施されれば、ＩＣＣの活動、献身的な職員、その家族に重大な影響を及ぼすことになる」などとする共同声明を発表した。

高市早苗首相も同日夜、米国の制裁が「日本の立場と相容れるものではなく、深く懸念している」と自身のソーシャルメディア「Ｘ」に投稿。「我が国は国際社会における法の支配を一貫して重視し、その役割を担うＩＣＣを支持している」とも改めて表明した。

ノルウェーに本拠地を置くノーベル賞委員会は同日、ＩＣＣで判事を務めたナビ・ピレイ氏にノーベル平和賞を授与すると発表した。これを受け、トランプ米大統領は自身が受賞できなかったことに不満を表明。恥ずべき不名誉な決定でノルウェーに汚点を残したなどと批判していた。

（鬼原民幸　編集：平田紀之）

item.title: El huracán Isaías se cobra cuatro vidas y deja a unos 670.000 personas sin electricidad en EEUU
item.description: Cuatro personas fallecieron tras la llegada del huracán Isaías a primera hora del sábado, y unos 670.000 habitantes de Florida, Alabama, Georgia y Misisipi seguían sin suministro eléctrico cuando la tormenta se debilitó hasta convertirse en un ciclón postropical, según autoridades locales y los servicios de seguimiento del suministro eléctrico en Estados Unidos.
item.dc:creator: Rhea Abraham, Rajveer Pardesi, Marianna Parraga
item.content:encoded: Cuatro personas fallecieron tras la llegada del huracán Isaías a primera hora del sábado, y unos 670.000 habitantes de Florida, Alabama, Georgia y Misisipi seguían sin suministro eléctrico cuando la tormenta se debilitó hasta convertirse en un ciclón postropical, según autoridades locales y los servicios de seguimiento del suministro eléctrico en Estados Unidos. Dos de las muertes se debieron a la caída de árboles sobre viviendas, según medios de comunicación locales y las autoridades. Las autoridades de Florida no habían recibido ninguna solicitud de búsqueda y rescate poco después de que la tormenta tocó tierra, lo que indica que el impacto fue limitado, dijo el gobernador Ron DeSantis. Sin embargo, seguían existiendo condiciones peligrosas y se esperaban marejadas ciclónicas, inundaciones repentinas, vientos destructivos y riesgo de tornados en algunas zonas del sureste de Estados Unidos, según el Centro Nacional de Huracanes (CNH). Se prevé que la amenaza de tornados continúe el sábado en algunas zonas del Panhandle de Florida, Georgia y las Carolinas, según el NHC. Otra tormenta en el océano Pacífico, "Rachel", se desplazaba el sábado hacia la costa del norte de Baja California, provocando ráfagas de viento y mareas más altas, lo que dejó a otras 7.000 personas sin electricidad en California. Isaías, un huracán de categoría 2 cuando tocó tierra en la costa de Florida y el primero de la temporada atlántica de 2026, se espera que genere rachas de viento en el interior antes de debilitarse por debajo de la fuerza de vendaval más tarde el sábado, según el CNH. Alrededor del 69% de la producción de petróleo y el 57% de la de gas natural en el golfo de México estadounidense seguían paralizados el sábado, lo que supone un ligero descenso con respecto a las cifras del viernes, según la Administración de Minerales Marinos. Unas 113 plataformas de producción, que representan el 30% del total, seguían evacuadas, según la agencia.

item.title: Nvidia in talks to invest further in Reflection AI or buy it, FT reports
item.description: Nvidia is in talks to deepen its investment in open-source startup Reflection AI or acquire it, the Financial Times reported on Saturday, citing people with direct knowledge of the matter.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Nvidia (NVDA.O) is in talks to deepen its investment in open-source startup Reflection AI or acquire it, the Financial Times reported on Saturday, citing people with direct knowledge of the matter. Talks are at an early stage and a deal could take several forms, including a so-called acqui-hire arrangement where Nvidia would hire staff and license technology rather than pursue a full acquisition, potentially avoiding a lengthy regulatory review, the newspaper said. An agreement could be reached in the coming weeks, according to the report, which cited multiple people familiar with the matter, while adding that the discussions could still fall apart. Reflection declined to comment on the FT report, while Nvidia did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Nvidia is already a major financial backer and strategic investor in Reflection AI, having invested $800 million in the startup, the FT reported. Founded in 2024 by former DeepMind researchers Misha Laskin and Ioannis Antonoglou, Reflection develops tools that automate software development, a fast-growing use case for AI. Reflection's chief executive, Laskin, told CNBC in April that the Nvidia-backed startup was raising fresh capital at a pre-money valuation of [USN:FWN4160Z3 TEXT:"$25 billion"]. The company on Monday launched its first open-weight model, [USN:L4N45R19C TEXT:"Beam,"] as it seeks to compete in coding and agentic tasks with lower-cost Chinese models such as DeepSeek and Kimi.

item.title: Report: Sam Fuld declines offer to head Athletics' front office
item.description: The Athletics will continue their search for a president of baseball operations after Sam Fuld declined an offer for the position, ESPN reported Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Athletics will continue their search for a president of baseball operations after Sam Fuld declined an offer for the position, ESPN reported Saturday. Fuld is the current president of business operations for the Philadelphia Phillies and will reportedly remain in the same job. Currently playing home games in Sacramento, Calif., the A's are scheduled to move into a stadium currently under construction in Las Vegas for the 2028 season. The A's fired general manager David Forst in August as the team limped to a 64-98 record. The franchise last had a winning season in 2021 and last made the playoffs in 2020, when the club advanced to the American League Division Series. According to ESPN, Boston Red Sox assistant general manager Taylor Smith is a top candidate to take over as A's president of baseball operations. --Field Level Media

item.title: Colts DE Arden Key (hamstring) lands on injured reserve
item.description: The Indianapolis Colts placed defensive end Arden Key on injured reserve Saturday with a hamstring injury.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Indianapolis Colts placed defensive end Arden Key on injured reserve Saturday with a hamstring injury. Key sustained the injury during Indianapolis' 30-13 victory over the Washington Commanders last Sunday in London. Key, 30, has recorded eight combined tackles, one forced fumble, 0.5 sacks and three quarterback hits in four starts in his first season with Indianapolis (2-2). He signed as a free agent in March. Key has 200 combined tackles, 31 sacks, 39 tackles for loss, five forced fumbles and two fumble recoveries in 120 regular-season games (50 starts) for the Oakland/Las Vegas Raiders (2018-20), San Francisco 49ers (2021), Jacksonville Jaguars (2022), Tennessee Titans (2023-25) and Colts. The Raiders selected Key in the third round of the 2018 NFL Draft out of LSU. Also on Saturday, the Colts elevated wide receiver Nick Westbrook-Ikhine from the practice squad to the active roster. He has appeared in two other games this season. --Field Level Media

item.title: Barcelona cruise past Getafe, Real Madrid stutter to win over Villarreal
item.description: Barcelona extended their perfect LaLiga start with a comfortable 3-0 home win over Getafe on Saturday before Real Madrid overcame Villarreal 1-0 despite having Vinicius Jr sent off.
item.dc:creator: Ruairidh Barlow
item.content:encoded: Barcelona extended their perfect LaLiga start with a comfortable 3-0 home win over Getafe on Saturday before Real Madrid overcame Villarreal 1-0 despite having Vinicius Jr sent off. Barca's victory makes it eight wins for Hansi Flick's side and maintains their five-point lead at the top over Atletico Madrid, who won 2-1 at Alaves with a late Cristian Romero goal. Real Madrid's narrow win keeps them in third place on 18 points, six points off the pace set by their arch-rivals, but Jose Mourinho is no closer to improving their performances. The three-week international break did little to disrupt Barcelona’s rhythm and they went ahead after two minutes when Anthony Gordon cut inside and saw his shot deflect off Getafe midfielder Mario Martin and beyond goalkeeper David Soria. The visitors struggled to escape their own half under sustained pressure and Gabriel Jesus punished a giveaway by Zaid Romero to score on the half-hour in his first start for Barca. The hosts remained firmly in control after the break, with Getafe testing Joan Garcia only once on the keeper’s return from injury. Jules Kounde, who missed a clear chance in the first half, completed the scoring for Barca in the 73rd minute with a simple finish from Lamine Yamal’s curling cross. MBAPPE HITS THE POST Real had the clearer first-half openings against Villarreal, with Kylian Mbappe's seventh-minute shot hitting the post. They remained unconvincing on the ball, although neither side was able to direct proceedings. Villarreal were equally imprecise with their passes and chances were in short supply. The tempo increased in the second half and Yan Diomande scored the winner when he beat the offside trap in the 63rd minute and found the bottom corner of the net. It was the Ivory Coast forward's first goal for Real since joining in August. A forlorn Vinicius Jr watched 19-year-old Diomande in the Brazilian's preferred left-wing position from the bench in the first half but was bright when he came on after 52 minutes to replace wing back Trent Alexander-Arnold.
